title: Phuket and Koh Samui Beach Escape
alt: Palm fringed sand and turquoise water on Chaweng beach in Koh Samui
transport: Shared coach transfers with ferry and speedboat crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: This one is built around slow days. One big island tour, then two mornings on Samui with nothing booked.
expert.tip: Hire a car with a driver for half a day on Samui and loop the ring road: Big Buddha temple, Wat Plai Laem, the Secret Buddha Garden and Lad Koh viewpoint in one easy run.

summary: Six easy days across two Thai islands. A speedboat tour of the Phi Phi group from Phuket, two unhurried nights near Chaweng beach on Koh Samui and a final Phuket night, with beach time built into every day.
included: Included: 5 nights in Phuket and Koh Samui with daily breakfast; Phi Phi islands speedboat tour with lunch; 12 airport, pier and island transfers including the Samui ferry crossings both ways.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; island and temple entry fees; lunches and dinners other than the island tour lunch; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Phuket International Airport and private sedan transfer to Patong
Check in at Club Bamboo and keep the first day free
Patong beach is a short walk down the hill from the resort
Optional: an evening on Patong beach or Phuket Bird Park with children
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Phuket pier
Speedboat transfer out to the Phi Phi group for the day
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, with lunch on the tour
Return speedboat and shared transfer to Patong in the evening
3: Breakfast, check out and shared transfer to the ferry terminal
Ferry transfer across to Koh Samui, then a shared transfer to your hotel
Check in near Chaweng beach and spend the evening on the sand
Optional: Fisherman's Village or the stalls at The Wharf Samui
4: Breakfast, then the whole day is yours on the island
Optional: Big Buddha temple, Wat Plai Laem and the Secret Buddha Garden
Optional: Lad Koh viewpoint on the ring road, best in morning light
Long swims and a sunset on Chaweng beach cost nothing at all
5: Breakfast, check out and shared transfer to the Samui pier
Ferry transfer back across to Phuket and on to Patong
Afternoon free for the pool, the spa or one more hour on the beach
Optional: a dolphin show, the Siam Niramit show or Muay Thai at Patong stadium
6: Breakfast and an unhurried check out
Private sedan transfer to Phuket International Airport

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Club Bamboo in Patong, a short walk from the beach

program.name: Patong base with a Phi Phi day
program.description: Two nights in Patong with one big day on the water, running out to Maya Bay and the Phi Phi group by speedboat.

activities.name: Phi Phi Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A full day across the Phi Phi group with Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, and lunch served on the tour.

activities.name: Evening on Patong Beach
activities.description: Walk the sand as the light goes, then browse the stalls and cafes a street back from the beach front.

activities.name: Phuket Bird Park
activities.description: A shaded park with macaws, hornbills and crowned cranes, plus short keeper talks. A simple hit with younger children.

stops.name: Koh Samui
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Close to Chaweng beach and the night market

program.name: Two slow days on Koh Samui
program.description: Nothing booked and nowhere to be. Chaweng beach on the doorstep, temples and viewpoints on the ring road when you feel like moving.

activities.name: Fisherman's Village
activities.description: Old wooden shophouses at Bophut turned into cafes and bars, with a walking street market on Friday evenings.

activities.name: Big Buddha Temple
activities.description: Wat Phra Yai on its small island, reached by causeway, with a golden seated Buddha looking out over the sea.

activities.name: Secret Buddha Garden
activities.description: Stone figures set among streams and jungle up in the hills, reached on a steep track best driven with a local driver.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Back at Club Bamboo in Patong for the final night

program.name: A final Phuket night
program.description: Back across from Samui for a last afternoon at the pool, with Patong close by for one more evening out.

activities.name: Siam Niramit Show
activities.description: A big stage production on Thai history and legend, with a hundred performers and an outdoor village to walk beforehand.

activities.name: Dolphin Show
activities.description: An hour of dolphin and sea lion routines in a covered arena, easy to fit into a free Phuket afternoon.
